changes: Move sparse residency acquisition out of locked scheduler completion callbacks, accumulating/coalescing completed fault ranges and resolving them before graphics/compute work. Drain completions created during residency too.
Upload the separate single-sample guest stencil plane with its own 8-bit layout and layer count; preserve pending depth dirty state on stencil-only upload.
Preserve GPU-owned stencil data in the buffer cache before reassociation or image retirement; preserve newer guest dirty data and distinguish unchanged neighboring-page writes.

Honor requested depth/stencil copy aspects. For a stencil copy between guest planes sharing one host image, use the guest buffer-backed transfer instead of overlapping Vulkan image self-copy; preserve untouched array layers.
Add sparse stencil upload/save/copy counters for native verification.
Authenticate sudo once after either native build or verified build reuse; all journal collectors remain noninteractive.
reference_scope: Independent adaptation of the separate stencil-plane upload proposal, with existing aspect-aware footprint arithmetic and additional dirty-state, ownership and copy handling.
causal_limits: The locking defect is reproduced from production callback code; a native stack trace has not tied it conclusively to the prior frozen black GoT builds.
No native game was run here. Missing graphics, cutscene stability and FPS must be verified on the user GPU.
